KnowledgeArticle.Title: Blocked Building Exit or Fire Escape
KnowledgeArticle.Description: Report partially or fully blocked building exits or fire escapes.

Section.Name: 911 Blocked Building Exit or Fire Escape
Section.Content:
Call 911
Call 911 to report an emergency situation or condition that might cause danger to life or personal property.

Need something else?

  • Fire Hazard to report potential fire related issues
  • Apartment Maintenance Complaint to report a broken door in a residential building
  • NYCHA Public Housing Maintenance Complaint to report a problem at a NYCHA public housing building

You can report a partially or fully blocked fire escape or secondary exit (also known as an egress). You also can report a secondary exit that's locked, sealed, or missing.

Include in your report:

  • What is blocking the exit
  • If the door is locked or sealed
  • If there is another way to get out of the building

Call 311 or 212-NEW-YORK (212-639-9675) to report the problem.
